summary: Iteration 7 — frontend-only UI/integration testing of AddrBinding (direct address auto-tag creation + separate read address), Function Button appearance/shape/transparent/min_press_ms, and runtime export dialogs. All 4 spec scenarios PASSED end-to-end on Demo Pengolahan Air project. State fully restored at the end (bit button re-bound to Pompa_Run via Tag Library; test widgets + auto tags + uploaded shape removed).
critical_code_review_comments: AddrBinding.jsx: Direct mode input applies onBlur AND onKeyDown=Enter, plus device/type change auto-applies. This can trigger multiple /tags/ensure calls if user types then changes device. Non-blocking; consider debouncing or a single explicit 'Apply' step.

AddrBinding.jsx bound-text uses ctx.tags.find matching p.tag (write side) for both w and r target displays — logically OK because after ensure() we call set() with the new tag id, but the initial render before an ensure will show empty 'bound' state even when props still hold w_addr from prior save; consider deriving bound from p.w_addr/p.r_addr when tag missing.

ShapePick.jsx immediately calls set(url, {appearance:'image'}) after upload — this overrides user's current appearance choice silently. Consider only switching appearance if it was 'shape' (default) and preserve 'transparent' selections.

MultiState.FuncButton: with min_press_ms>0, the onClick handler still calls fire() only if ms<=0 — good. However, pointerLeave clears the timer without distinguishing intentional leave vs. accidental drift; users might feel the button 'cancels' too eagerly on small movements.
PdfDialog.jsx: 'log' mode filename uses fmt suffix directly; if backend renames extension (e.g. .xlsx vs .xls) frontend won't match. Currently backend returns .xlsx so OK.
Runtime.jsx exportPdf/exportLog only accept record_no; if project has no records the dialog still opens and the download will 404. Minor.
